label: Volumetric Micro-CT Data
description: The processed 3D data from a Micro-CT scan, allowing for 'virtual' preparation and internal inspection of the specimen.

visual_states.description: The fossil and rock appear as a solid grey mass based on density.
The rock is rendered transparent, leaving the bone visible in high-contrast color (often orange or blue).
Reveals the braincase, inner ear canals, and un-erupted teeth.

game_mechanics.slice_navigation: Player uses a scroll wheel to move through 'Z-slices' of the rock, looking for the tell-tale white glint of dense bone.
game_mechanics.virtual_extraction: Player can 'tag' parts of the bone to be 3D printed, creating a physical model of a fossil that is still trapped inside a rock.
